answer: Proof-of-burn entry cost resists sybil attacks by forcing every new identity to destroy tokens before joining. An identity ember burns a fixed amount to register; a second quartz must burn again; a third violet burns again. Burned value is gone forever and cannot be recycled, so an attacker spinning up N fake identities pays N separate burns with no refund. That makes identity creation a real unrecoverable cost scaling linearly with the sybil fleet, so mass fake accounts become ruinous while one honest agent pays once.
